_comment: Claude Code / Claude Desktop: drop this under mcpServers in ~/.claude.json,
~/.claude/settings.json, or claude_desktop_config.json. No key needed: without
one the agent gets the guest tools (check_feasible, observe_world, do_in_world,
find_out, job_status, job_receipt, job_evidence, list_bids). A posted job comes
back with pay_at and token. Or, on the command line:
claude mcp add --transport http lamdis https://exchange.lamdis.ai/mcp
Then ask: 'Find out whether the For Lease sign is still up at 1200 Valencia St,
pay $8' and send the person the pay link.
